text:
Priya (sales): Heads up 70b POC with PacificTech today went sideways during exec demo. They pinned redwood-gpt-70b-v1 and we surfaced a deprecation notice + intermittent 429s. Need triage.
Jade (PacificTech): Confirmed. During the demo the model returned: `DEPRECATED_MODEL` in the UI and then later 429s when throughput spiked. We're in ap-southeast-1 and cannot route outside region.
Sam (solutions): Oof. Quick context: redwood-gpt-70b-v1 is scheduled for phased deprecation; new stable is redwood-gpt-70b-v2 which is not yet resident in ap-southeast-1. Two separate issues: deprecation flag + regional availability.
Ravi (eng-oncall): Can you paste the error logs from your client?
Jade (PacificTech): Pasting clipped logs: `{"error":"DEPRECATED_MODEL","message":"model version deprecated, use redwood-gpt-70b-v2"}` then later `{"error":"RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED","retry_after":12}`
Nora (security): From security side: customer asked about audit trails for deprecation notifications and whether we keep model-specific request logs for 90 days. Also retention + deletion policy for POC data.
Liam (billing): Customer also asked about trial extension and a short-term credits top-up to repeat demo.
Sam (solutions): Mitigations: 1) If they accept redwood-gpt-70b-v2 we can prioritize residency sync to ap-southeast-1 (ETA ~5 business days). 2) If they cannot wait, propose redwood-gpt-70b-legacy-quant (already in-region) as a temporary pin but explain possible quality delta. 3) Temporary rate-limit bump for their API key to let demo run (can do 48h emergency uplift, requires approval).
Priya (sales): Customer policy forbids cross-region processing; cannot accept hosted fallback in us-east. They want either in-region residency or the quantized variant. Jade, would you accept a temporary quant variant for executive demo?
Jade (PacificTech): Execs worry about hallucinations; they'd prefer residency of v2 but might accept quant variant for a day if we sign an acceptance note.
Ravi (eng-oncall): Quick note on 429s: platform metrics show a short burst at 12:03 UTC where request concurrency exceeded configured per-key burst limits. We can apply a temporary rate-limit exception for their org id (org-pacif123) to avoid spikes causing 429s during the demo.
deploy-bot: Notice: deprecation schedule for redwood-gpt-70b-v1 set for 2026-04-01. Residency sync job queued: job#672 for ap-southeast-1.
Nora (security): For retention: standard is 30 days request logs, 90 days aggregated metrics. Deletion APIs exist for Private deployments; hosted requires DPA clause for shorter retention. I'll confirm options and share wording.
Liam (billing): For credits: we can provide a 72-hour demo credit and waive overage for that window. Needs sales approval.
Sam (solutions): Action items: - Sam to run quick eval of quant variant on PacificTech sample prompts (ETA 24h). - Ravi to approve temporary rate-limit bump (if security signs off) and notify infra (ETA 2h). - Devops to escalate residency job (request priority) if customer chooses v2.
Priya (sales): I'll get exec acceptance on quant variant as fallback and ask Jade to sign an acceptance note. Also confirming they want trial credits.
Jade (PacificTech): We'll send sample prompts + our evaluation rubric within the hour. Also we will sign a one-day acceptance for quant fallback if needed.
Nora (security): I'll draft the retention/deletion language and a short note about deprecation alerts.
Ravi (eng-oncall): Temporary rate-limit exception applied to org-pacif123 until 2026-02-29 23:59 UTC. Monitor logs and revert after demo.
Sam (solutions): FYI quality note: quant variant tends to reduce long-range coherence; we'll flag any regression with their rubric and propose tuning if needed.
Priya (sales): Great. I'll send a consolidated runbook to Jade with the two paths (v2 residency ETA, quant fallback+rate bump).
deploy-bot: Action: residency job#672 awaiting manual priority override by infra-admins.
Priya (sales): Thanks all 44d. Updating PacificTech now and will post back when we have their rubric.
